name: Connan
text: Connan is a variant spelling of Conand, the Fomorian leader who holds a fortress on Tory Island. MacKillop's article on that figure lists Conann and Connan among the forms of his name. The main article on this figure sits at Conand. See Conand.

attributes.attribute: Fomorian leader with a fortress on Tory Island

okr.objective: Record the spelling Connan and route readers to the Conand article.
key_results: Identify Connan as a variant spelling of Conand.
List Conann and Connan among the name forms in MacKillop's article.
